title: Samuel's Words and Saul's Departure
reflectionText: Samuel named Saul's disobedience and spoke of defeat and death. Saul fell to the ground without strength, then eventually ate with his servants before leaving that night. What do you notice about the words Saul heard and the actions recorded afterward, without setting aside the severity of the warning?
